## History

Herb Spencer is a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Following [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's return to the community, Herb is mentioned as one of the local young men who has been frequently calling on the terminally ill [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md).
